name: Heri-Zhang 2025: diode, trapezoid short pulse (1D)
description:
Paper-parameter PIC example; exact reproduction is not claimed. Nominal FWHM tau=k*T; equal total injected charge for all three profiles. Trapezoid ramp fraction 0.15 and Gaussian cutoff are inferred, not reported inputs. The paper FWHM-label and full-support arrival-span metrics must be distinguished. History electrode currents are collected currents; the paper induced current requires sum(|q|*w*vz)/D. This is the verified initial fixed-total-charge trial Q/A=f*eps0*V0/D, not the separately audited duration-dependent cold-cathode critical-charge normalization. See SHORT_PULSE_EXAMPLES.md. Source DOI 10.1109/TED.2025.3552061.

Pulse setup: edit named values under Parameters, and the expression under Emission > pulse > Current density [A/m^2]. t is solver time [s]; u=t+sample_dt/2 samples the midpoint of the current step. The where((u>=0)&(u<support),1,0) gate emits only for 0 <= u < support; & means both comparisons must hold. Keep emitter t_start=0, t_stop=support and simulation dt=sample_dt. support is full pulse duration [s]; tau=k*T is FWHM [s]. Jamp=pulse_charge_per_area/pulse_area_time is peak current density [A/m^2], not total current. pulse_charge_per_area=f*sigma_ref [C/m^2]; pulse_area_time is the integral of the dimensionless pulse shape [s]. sample_dt=support/ceil(support/(dt_fraction*T)) aligns support to whole steps; dt_fraction=0.0002 is the requested maximum step / T. Trapezoid: with u=t+sample_dt/2, rise linearly from 0 to Jamp over 0 <= u < ramp_fraction*support; stay at Jamp until u=(1-ramp_fraction)*support; then fall linearly to zero at u=support. ramp_fraction is EACH ramp duration / full support (0 < ramp_fraction <= 0.5; default 0.15). The min/max terms clip the shape between 0 and 1. support=tau/(1-ramp_fraction); pulse_area_time=support*(1-ramp_fraction).
Current density expression: Jamp*(max(0,min(1,min((t+sample_dt/2)/support,1-(t+sample_dt/2)/support)/ramp_fraction)))*where(((t+sample_dt/2)>=0)&((t+sample_dt/2)<support),1,0)
